items.text: PROMPT SHARE: The future doesn’t need to look like chrome and neon. #Marketing #Branding #Advertising #Kling #Kling3 #KlingAI @Kling_ai This is why: Minimalism can feel more advanced than spectacle. Clean geometry. Controlled movement. Heavy styling. Not spaceships or cyberpunk overload. Just a familiar human silhouette pushed a few years beyond the present through styling, movement, and atmosphere. Kling gives creators cinematic movement and character consistency without forcing every shot into an obvious AI aesthetic. Paid partnership with Kling. ➜ Image Prompt: Create a hyper-realistic full-body contemporary menswear editorial portrait of a strikingly handsome adult East Asian man with refined, high-fashion model-like features, a lean athletic build, strong cheekbones, a defined jawline, clear natural skin, and an extremely short dark buzz cut. He has a calm, slightly detached expression and looks directly into the camera. Style him in an all-black layered avant-garde outfit. He wears a long, structured black overcoat falling to approximately knee level, left open to reveal a black collared shirt with subtle tonal geometric texture and understated black buttons. Pair it with relaxed black trousers that taper slightly toward the ankles, a minimalist black leather belt, and substantial black leather lace-up combat boots with thick soles. Keep the entire wardrobe monochromatic black, sophisticated, slightly oversized, and fashion-forward, with realistic differences in fabric texture separating each layer. Pose him casually against a raw urban architectural wall, with a pale concrete or stone-panel facade behind him and an industrial metal roll-up door visible along one side. He stands with his weight shifted naturally onto one leg, one knee slightly bent and one foot positioned subtly forward. One hand rests naturally inside his trouser pocket while the other hangs near his waist, creating an understated editorial stance rather than a rigid symmetrical pose. Photograph his entire body from head to toe, including both boots completely within the frame. Use a slightly wide environmental-fashion composition from approximately waist-to-chest camera height, with enough surrounding architecture to establish the gritty urban setting without overpowering him. Use a direct on-camera flash aesthetic, as though photographed spontaneously at night or in deep shade with a high-end compact film camera. The flash should illuminate his face, clothing, and nearby concrete while allowing the surroundings to fall slightly darker. Include realistic flash shadows against the wall, subtle highlight reflections on the leather boots, mild exposure imperfections, restrained analog grain, and slightly cool urban color rendering. The overall aesthetic should feel like Tokyo street-style photography crossed with an underground luxury fashion editorial: minimalist, raw, slightly rebellious, expensive without appearing polished or commercial, and convincingly photographed rather than digitally rendered. Hyper-realistic photography, stunning model-like facial features, authentic skin pores and micro-texture, natural complexion variation, individual hair detail, realistic eyes, accurate facial anatomy, premium wool and cotton textures, subtle tonal fabric patterns, realistic leather, natural garment folds, physically accurate hands and fingers, realistic body proportions, authentic direct-flash photography, subtle 35mm film grain, high dynamic range, crisp subject detail, natural imperfections, no fake skin, no plastic skin, no waxy complexion, no excessive smoothing, no CGI appearance, no animated look, no distorted anatomy, no warped hands, no malformed boots, no image degradation.

items.text: Midjourney 8.2 vs ChatGPT 2.5 on a few simple prompts. Chat is the one on the left. I think Midjourney wins this first one decisively. Prompt: in a still from a period indie movie set in 1973, a handsome, brown haired, 27-year-old male songwriter, longish hair, stands on the balcony of the Chateau Marmont hotel in Hollywood, in the morning, he wears jeans and no shirt and is barefoot, slim, having a coffee and a cigarette, thinking about life. he can see a billboard down sunset blvd advertising the album The Best of The Doors.
